Class LobbySummaryPayload

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.prelobby.LobbySummaryPayload
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LobbySummaryPayload extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a simplified snapshot/summary of a single lobby room on the server.

This is used to display the list of joinable rooms to players in the pre-lobby.
